body: … has gotten a lot of response – 7000+ comments, 14000 Facebook recommendations, etc. I’ll choose a few of the most critical responses to respond to in a few days. Many of the comments make clear how much we need to reflect on the subject of my new book … Thanks for all who have come out to the book tour events, responded with your honest feedback to the op-ed (whether positively, critically, or negatively), and started needed conversations about Christian identity in a multi-faith world.
